question: What is the result for those who find liberation after enjoying all pleasures?
premises: Those with qualities become oceans of merit.
They find liberation after enjoying all pleasures.
Thus merit and liberation follow enjoyment.
inference: Enjoyment of all pleasures culminates in liberation for the qualified.
uncertainties: Fused sandhi forms obscure exact word boundaries.
plain_english: Thus even the qualified become oceans of merit; they find liberation after enjoying all pleasures.
